param.label: Phyloseq object (format rdata)
param.help: This is the result of FROGS_Stat Phyloseq Import Data tool.

param.label: Grouping variable
param.help: Experimental variable used to group samples (Treatment, Host type, etc).

param.label: Taxonomic level to filter your data
param.help: Ex: Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species

param.label: Taxa (at the above taxonomic level) to keep in the dataset
param.help: Ex: Bacteria (when filtering at the Kingdom level), Firmicutes (when filtering at the Phylum level). Multiple taxa (separated by a space) can be specified, i.e. Firmicutes Proteobacteria

param.label: Taxonomic level used for aggregation
param.help: Ex: Family (when filtering at the Phylum level). The aggregation level must be below the filtering level

param.label: Number of most abundant taxa to keep
param.help: Ex: 9, i.e. Tool keeps the 9 most abundant taxa and the remaining taxa are aggregated in a group 'Other'
